resources.sampling: Current Windows working set after each model, not continuous peak; unavailable on other systems

defaultSelection.scope: Presentation choice before new cases, not scientific preregistration; retain this selection even if its result is zero or unavailable.

audit.inheritedPremiseScope: Accepted immutable global monotonicity/contraction and q_star/C_star/rho certificates reused through verified live manifest/audit/output/source hashes; not independently recomputed in this stage. Legacy administrative oldCheckpointHashes are historical references, not new timing-model inputs, and are not recursively expanded
audit.scope: Separate JS BigInt finite/control arithmetic and complete scientific-field/clock/credit/preview audit; separate130-digit code checks128 scalar-root signs/model,64 orbit propagation rows/model and every queried continuous contraction-tail sum. Shared JS Math for numerical-game payoffs and shared Python Decimal backend disclosed. No formal verification or new learning experiment.
audit.continuousBridgeScope: Fresh recomputation in authoritative Python process; no saved/unvalidated bridge cache accepted as full audit

meta.scope: Same physical cap and full guard; every activation prefix, every allowed seller response and realized controller path. Rule-frequency comparison is not monetary cost, behavior, equilibrium or empirical-market validation. Finite exact saved-weight results and continuous enclosures are separate populations.
meta.provenance: All compact models regenerated read-only from the complete independently accepted raw study, with exact source/output/journal/completion bindings and byte comparison to the saved summary. Eight unchanged full finite games are separately index-bound. No new market optimization or learned-policy replay.
meta.playerScope: Manual finite interaction controls both shops; no model players in that interaction. No new language-model/chat/API seller calls or learner training. Codex development assistance is disclosed separately.
